style: Create a premium university-level scientific educational 3D-rendered illustration, physically plausible realistic materials, carefully modeled recognizable objects, restrained elegant composition, soft natural studio lighting from upper left, convincing contact shadows, detailed but readable geometry, pale near-white cool neutral environment compatible with Masaarat soft blue and mint overlays.
